chapter_title_en: The Resentment of the Death Heaven Palace
chapter_seo_title: The Resentment Entity and Keke's Imprisonment in Seven Dead Cities
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen faces an invisible horror in the Death Palace, learns of the Heavenly Emperor's ancient deed, and arrives at seven dead cities imprisoning Keke.
og_title: Death Palace Entity and the Seven Dead Cities
og_description: In the depths of the Death World, a pale face haunts Xiao Chen's group, revealing the Heavenly Emperor's dark secret. Then they find Keke held in seven deadly cities.
twitter_title: Death Palace Horror and the Big Dipper Prison
twitter_description: A malevolent resentment entity stalks Xiao Chen. After escaping, he finds Keke trapped in seven dead cities guarded by Otherworld gods.
